claims.text: The FDA ketoconazole label reports exceptional cases of disulfiram-like reactions to alcohol, with flushing, rash, peripheral edema, nausea, and headache.
claims.quote: Alcohol: Exceptional cases have been reported of a disulfiram-like reaction to alcohol, characterized by flushing, rash, peripheral edema, nausea and headache.
